Starry Initials: 2 directions

"Make me a font like Starry Night." A color display face in the manner of that painting: short, loaded brush marks that follow the form, a night sky that turns, rings of light around everything bright. For titles and posters. It must stay readable, and it must not copy the painting.

Send feedback

Your picks, slider settings and notes go back to the agent, which then revises the fonts.
